entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 45238: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, HIP 45238: the Hipparcos parallax (van Leeuwen 2007) the radius is computed with, 28.82 +/- 0.11 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1134/S1063773712050015): 34.698 +/- 0.132 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 45238 (same row): -156.47, 108.95 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331, XHIP, HIP 45238: RV -5.1 +/- 2.3 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 5.93 +/- 0.26 solar radii from Computed here, not printed by a paper: 5.93 +/- 0.26 solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.59 +/- 0.07 mas of Hanbury Brown, Davis & Allen (1974), MNRAS 167, 121 (the Narrabri intensity interferometer; Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, Table 1, and the JMDC) and the Hipparcos parallax 28.82 +/- 0.11 mas (van Leeuwen 2007, XHIP) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/167.1.121). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 9240 +/- 220 K from Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, HD 80007: effective temperature 9240 +/- 220 K (Table 6), from the measured angular diameter and the star's flux from the ultraviolet to the infrared.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 9,240 K and log g 3.16 (u1 0.262, u2 0.323): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
